model_response:
**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP (内源), β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** uDISCO (Ultimate DISCO) is specifically optimized for clearing large, intact samples like the whole mouse CNS (35–40 mm). It provides high transparency and, crucially, induces significant tissue shrinkage (approx. 60% volume reduction), which is essential for imaging a sample of this length within the limited travel range and working distance of light-sheet microscopes. The dual-labeling strategy utilizes endogenous GFP to highlight specific cortical projections and β-III Tubulin (Tuj1) immunolabeling to visualize the global axonal framework. This allows for the precise tracing of long-range fibers against the background neuro-architecture, facilitating the analysis of pathfinding, branching, and terminal distribution across the entire brain-spinal cord axis.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Pre-treatment and Permeabilization
1.1 Wash fixed CNS in 0.1M PBS to remove residual fixative.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
1.2 Incubation in Permeabilization Solution (PBS with 0.5% Triton X-100, 0.3M glycine, and 20% DMSO).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
1.3 Incubation in Blocking Solution (PBS with 0.5% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, and 6% donkey serum).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

2 Immunolabeling
2.1 Incubation with primary antibody (β-III Tubulin/Tuj1, 1:300 dilution in Blocking Solution).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.2 Wash in PTw solution (PBS with 0.2% Tween-20).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.3 Incubation with secondary antibody (Alexa Fluor 647, 1:500 dilution in Blocking Solution).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.4 Wash in PTw solution.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 uDISCO Dehydration
3.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) tert-butanol aqueous solution.(Temperature: 35 ℃, Time: 4 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) tert-butanol aqueous solution.(Temperature: 35 ℃, Time: 4 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) tert-butanol aqueous solution.(Temperature: 35 ℃, Time: 4 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) tert-butanol aqueous solution.(Temperature: 35 ℃, Time: 4 hours)
3.5 Incubation with 90% (vol/vol) tert-butanol aqueous solution.(Temperature: 35 ℃, Time: 4 hours)
3.6 Incubation with 96% (vol/vol) tert-butanol aqueous solution.(Temperature: 35 ℃, Time: 4 hours)
3.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) tert-butanol.(Temperature: 35 ℃, Time: 4 hours)

4 Delipidation and RI Matching
4.1 Incubation with Dichloromethane (DCM, Sigma 270997) for delipidation.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.2 Incubation with BABB-D4 refractive index matching solution (BABB:DPE = 4:1 vol/vol; BABB is Benzyl Alcohol:Benzyl Benzoate = 1:2).(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
4.3 Storage in fresh BABB-D4 solution protected from light prior to light-sheet imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

The methanol and DCM pretreatment steps ensure deep penetration of the CD31 antibody into the dense tumor core and surrounding brain tissue. By using in vivo-injected Lectin to mark functional, perfused vessels and ex vivo CD31 staining to mark the entire endothelial network, this approach allows for the precise 3D quantification of perfusion deficits and vessel normalization. DBE provides a high refractive index (RI ≈ 1.56) matching the dehydrated tissue, enabling high-resolution light-sheet imaging of the entire 8x6x4 mm volume.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Pretreatment and Permeabilization
1.1 Incubation with a graded methanol series (20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% vol/vol) in PBS for 1 hour each step.(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour to ensure complete dehydration.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) / 33% (vol/vol) methanol for delipidation.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM for delipidation.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with a reverse graded methanol series (80%, 60%, 40%, 20% vol/vol) in PBS for 1 hour each step.(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
1.6 Incubation with PTxwH buffer (PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100, 10 μg/ml Heparin, and 0.1% Tween-20).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

2 Immunolabeling
2.1 Incubation with Permeabilization Solution (PTxwH with 20% DMSO and 2.3% Glycine).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Incubation with Blocking Solution (PTxwH with 10% DMSO and 6% Donkey Serum).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.3 Incubation with Primary Antibody: Rat anti-CD31 (1:100 dilution in PTxwH with 5% DMSO and 3% Donkey Serum).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)

2.6 Washing with PTxwH buffer for 5 times, 1 hour each.(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 hours)

3 Dehydration and Clearing
3.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** PEGASOS
**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato, Pan-Cytokeratin+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** PEGASOS (Polyethylene Glycol-Associated Solvent System) is selected because it excels at preserving endogenous fluorescence (tdTomato/RFP) by maintaining an alkaline environment (pH 9.5-10) using Quadrol. Unlike electrophoresis, it is a passive clearing method that minimizes structural deformation and tissue damage. It is highly compatible with whole-mount immunolabeling (Pan-Cytokeratin) and provides excellent transparency for imaging deep structures like brain metastases. The inclusion of DAPI ensures a strong reference signal for brain parenchyma, while Alexa Fluor 647 provides high-contrast labeling of the tumor boundaries without spectral overlap with tdTomato.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 **Pre-treatment and Delipidation**
1.1 Incubation with PEGASOS-D solution (25% wt/vol Quadrol, 10% wt/vol Urea, 10% wt/vol Triton X-100 in H2O) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
1.2 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100 (PBST) three times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours per wash)

2 **Immunolabeling**
2.1 Incubation with blocking buffer (10% Normal Goat Serum in PBST). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Incubation with primary antibody Pan-Cytokeratin (diluted 1:200 in blocking buffer). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)
2.3 Wash with PBST five times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours per wash)
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibody Alexa Fluor 647 and DAPI (diluted 1:500 and 1:1000 respectively in blocking buffer). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)
2.5 Wash with PBST five times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours per wash)

3 **Dehydration**
3.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) PEG-tB solution (t-Butanol, PEG-400, and Quadrol mixed in a 70:25:5 ratio, then diluted to 30% with H2O). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) PEG-tB solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) PEG-tB solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) PEG-tB solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

4 **Tissue Clearing and RI Matching**
4.1 Incubation with BB-PEG clearing solution (Benzyl Benzoate, PEG-400, and Quadrol mixed in a 75:20:5 ratio). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours or until transparent)
4.2 Storage in fresh BB-PEG solution at RT in the dark until imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: Indefinite)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFAP, β-III Tubulin (TUJ1), Alexa Fluor 568, Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected because it is specifically optimized for deep immunolabeling and clearing of large, dense CNS tissues like the rat spinal cord. The methanol-based pretreatment and bleaching steps are essential for enhancing antibody penetration through the dense glial scar and myelin-rich white matter. GFAP and β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) are the gold-standard markers for reactive astrocytes and axons, respectively, allowing for the visualization of the scar boundary and potential axonal regeneration. The high refractive index matching with DBE (RI ≈ 1.56) ensures the transparency required to image the entire 40 mm length and 4 mm thickness of the spinal cord using light-sheet microscopy.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Pretreatment and Permeabilization
1.1 Incubation with a graded methanol series (20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% vol/vol in PBS) for dehydration.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours each)
1.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for a second time to ensure complete dehydration.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
1.3 Incubation with chilled 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes 100% methanol) to bleach pigments and enhance permeabilization.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.4 Incubation with a graded methanol series (80%, 60%, 40%, 20% vol/vol in PBS) for rehydration.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours each)
1.5 Incubation with PTx2 (PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.6 Incubation with Permeabilization Solution (PTx2 / 2.3% wt/vol Glycine / 20% vol/vol DMSO).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
1.7 Incubation with Blocking Solution (PTx2 / 10% vol/vol DMSO / 6% vol/vol Donkey Serum).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

2 Immunolabeling
2.1 Incubation with Primary Antibodies (GFAP and β-III Tubulin/TUJ1, 1:200 dilution) in PTwH (PBS with 0.2% Tween-20 and 10 μg/ml Heparin) containing 5% vol/vol DMSO and 3% vol/vol Donkey Serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 6 days)
2.2 Incubation with PTwH for washing, with at least 5 buffer changes.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.3 Incubation with Secondary Antibodies (Alexa Fluor 568 and Alexa Fluor 647, 1:400 dilution) and DAPI (1 μg/ml) in PTwH containing 3% vol/vol Donkey Serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 6 days)
2.4 Incubation with PTwH for washing, with at least 5 buffer changes.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Dehydration and Clearing
3.1 Incubation with a graded methanol series (20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% vol/vol in water) for final dehydration.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours each)
3.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for a second time.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
3.3 Incubation with a mixture of 1 volume Methanol and 2 volumes Dichloromethane (DCM) until the sample sinks.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM to remove methanol and lipids.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl ether (DBE) for refractive index matching.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
3.6 Storage in fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE in a dark, airtight glass container until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: Indefinite)
